full_prompt_en: A square contemporary graphic-novel illustration shows a crowded tram interior, with a white-haired woman in black glasses seated prominently at the front. She wears a bright rust-red blouse and an olive shoulder strap, looking calmly toward the right rather than at the viewer. At left, a brown-haired young man in a green shirt peers over a seat back. Rows of passengers fill the middle distance, their faces simplified but distinct; metal poles, hanging hand loops, and large side windows establish the vehicle. A surprising autumn tree spreads branches and amber leaves across the upper left and central aisle, blending a natural motif into the everyday transit scene. The seats are muted sage green, the walls and ceiling cream gray, and the windows glow with soft daylight. Thin, precise ink contours and light crosshatching define faces, leaves, and upholstery, while transparent flat washes keep the palette airy. The foreground woman is the clearest color accent; the crowd behind her becomes a rhythm of smaller heads and warm gray coats. The framing is eye level and fairly wide, allowing the branching tree and compressed rows to share the square. It feels observational, slightly surreal, and emotionally quiet. Fine sketch marks remain visible instead of a glossy digital finish. No dialogue bubble, caption, or title interrupts the scene.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形当代图像小说插画描绘拥挤电车内部，白发戴黑框眼镜的女子显著坐在前方。她穿明亮铁锈红衬衫，肩上有橄榄色背带，平静看向右边而非观者。左侧棕发年轻男子从座椅靠背上探出。乘客列队填满中景，面孔简化却各不相同；金属杆、悬挂拉环和宽侧窗标明车厢。一棵出人意料的秋树把枝条和琥珀叶伸过左上和中央通道，将自然图案揉入日常通勤场景。座椅低调鼠尾草绿，墙与顶奶油灰，窗外透进柔日光。细而精准的墨线与轻微排线刻出脸、叶和座垫，透明平涂洗色让配色轻盈。前景女子是最清楚的彩色重音；后方人群变成较小头部与暖灰外套的节奏。机位平视且较宽，使分枝树和压缩座排同处方形画幅。场景有观察感、微微超现实且情绪安静。细草绘痕仍在，没有发亮数码完成感。没有对话框、字幕或标题打断画面。
style_prompt_en: Contemporary graphic-novel drawing with thin precise ink contours, selective crosshatching, and translucent muted washes. Sage, cream gray, warm amber, and one stronger rust-red accent build a restrained hierarchy. Crowded repeated small shapes recede in orderly rows while an organic branching rhythm crosses the frame. Eye-level observation, visible sketch texture, and soft daylight keep the scene airy, intimate, and slightly uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 当代图像小说绘制结合纤细精准墨轮廓、选择性排线与半透明低调洗色。鼠尾草绿、奶油灰、暖琥珀和一处较强铁锈红重音建立克制层级。密集重复的小形状沿有序行列后退，有机分枝节奏横贯画幅。平视观察、可见草绘纹理与柔日光令场景轻盈、亲密而微微奇异。
theme_en: A white-haired woman seated on a crowded tram beneath autumn branches
theme_zh: 秋枝下拥挤电车里坐着的白发女子
name: Asaf Hanuka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
